This site collects notes, code, and results for the background model project.

## Overview

- [EM notes](em.html): Poisson nonnegative matrix factorization and EM derivations.
- [Derivations (short version)](bg_theory.html): Mathematical justifications for EBPMF-BG updates.
- [Implementation](bg_implement.html): EBPMF-BG algorithm implementation, based on results derived in [Derivations (short version)](bg_theory.html),
- [EBPMF-BG on a "Easy" Simulated Example](bg_sim.html): Showcase EBPMF-BG on a toy example following EBPMF-BG model assumptions.
- [EBPMF-BG on newsgroups](bg_news.html): On newsgroups dataset, compare fasttopics and EBPMF-BG performance.
- [Gamma priors](gamma.html): Visualize different choices of gamma priors.

## Helpful R Files
- bg_post.R: referred to in bg_sim and bg_news. For plotting, factorization results analysis.
- newsgroups.R: Similar to [EBPMF-BG on newsgroups](bg_news.html), compare fasttopics and bg model runs on fasttopics.

## Experiments
- [Impact of bad newsgroups dataset sampling](bg_newsbadsample.html): On newsgroups dataset, compare fasttopics and EBPMF-BG performance working with a subset of newsgroups.

## Outdated 
- [EBPMF-gamma](ebpmf_gamma.html): Messy work on EBPMF with initial 1 gammamix priors on F, contains some efforts in GTEx data processing.
